quiz.3.question: 'Deep opaque colour, blackberry and volcanic ash aromas, extremely powerful thick tannins' — which variety is most likely?
quiz.3.explanation: Deep opaque colour + volcanic ash and dark fruit aromas + massively powerful, thick tannins = Aglianico — especially from volcanic soils (Taurasi, Aglianico del Vulture). Nebbiolo is paler; Sangiovese has dusty, not thick tannins.
